BOOTDISK.description: Device file of the boot disk

BOOTPART.description: Device file of the boot partition

BOOTDIR.description: Mount point of the boot partition

CHKBOOT_DATA.description: Directory to store CHKBOOT data and hash databases

CHANGES_ALERT.description: Filename for the alert file reporting boot changes

CHANGES_LOG.description: Filename for the log file tracking boot changes

CHKBOOT_STYLES.description: Comma-separated list of alert styles to use (e.g., issue, profile)

HIGHLIGHT_COLOUR.description: ANSI color code for highlighting (e.g., 31 = red)
